main_text.p: beam denarios trecenos ex omni summa ei, heredi'ue e-ius. quæsitum est de obligatione usurarum : quoniā numerus mensium qui solutioni cōpetebat, transierat. dicebam,quia pactaincontinenti facta, stipulationi inesse creduntur: perinde esse,ac si per singulos menses certā pecuniā stipulatus, quoad tardius soluta esset,usuras adiecissēt. igitur finito primo mēse,primę penfionis usuras currere. Et similiter post secundum & tertiū tractum,usuras non solutę pecuniae pēfionis crescere: nec ante fortis non solutæ usuras peti posse,q; ipsa fors pe

page.notes: The running head is a heavy, partly smudged line of type at the top; its words cannot be read, so it is marked illegible. The catchword "ti" is at the foot right and is not repeated in the text. The text ends mid-word ("pe"), as printed. Doubtful: "heredi'ue" (apostrophe as printed), and the abbreviation after "posse," which I have written as q; for -que. No margin notes on this page.
